Instead citing two independently-run, project-specific admin records that place the project in a pre-construction/proposed stage consistent with the recorded Status: (1) Guangxi natural-resources-department land pre-approval registry (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn via Wayback), approved 2024-04-02, project name matches verbatim; (2) an EIA public-participation notice reprint (yanshougs.com, dated 2023-10-24) for the same project name, builder 广西燃气集团有限公司. Medium tier because the support is inferential (process stage) rather than an explicit status statement.
